description: This file defines the CachedStorage class in Drupal, which implements caching logic for configuration storage, including methods for reading, writing, deleting, renaming, and listing configuration data with cache invalidation and prefix-based search.

classes.name: Drupal\Core\Config\CachedStorage
classes.description: Implements a cached configuration storage with methods for data retrieval, modification, and cache management, including prefix-based listing and cache invalidation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that injects the underlying storage and cache backend.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Checks if a configuration item exists in storage.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads a configuration item, utilizing cache if available.

methods.name: readMultiple
methods.description: Reads multiple configuration items, utilizing cache and storage as needed.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes configuration data to storage and updates cache.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a configuration item from storage and cache.

methods.name: rename
methods.description: Renames a configuration item in storage and updates cache.

methods.name: encode
methods.description: Encodes data using the underlying storage's method.

methods.name: decode
methods.description: Decodes raw data using the underlying storage's method.

methods.name: listAll
methods.description: Lists all configuration items, optionally filtered by prefix.

methods.name: findByPrefix
methods.description: Finds configuration names starting with a given prefix, with caching.

methods.name: deleteAll
methods.description: Deletes all configuration items matching a prefix.

methods.name: createCollection
methods.description: Creates a new collection of configuration items.

methods.name: getCollectionName
methods.description: Returns the name of the current collection.

methods.name: getCacheKey
methods.description: Generates a cache key for a configuration name.

methods.name: getCacheKeys
methods.description: Generates cache keys for multiple configuration names.

methods.name: getCollectionPrefix
methods.description: Returns the prefix used for cache keys based on collection name.
